name: [🎓] Run a Cheer Gym
desc:
Build your dream cheerleading empire from the ground up! Start with a small gym, recruit your first athletes, and grow into one of the biggest cheer gyms around.

✨ **BUILD & CUSTOMIZE**
🏠 Build and expand your own cheer gym
🎨 Customize your gym with different colors, decorations, equipment, and layouts
⬆️ Upgrade your gym and unlock new areas as you level up

📣 **CREATE YOUR CHEER TEAM**
⭐ Scout and recruit new athletes
🎀 Create your own cheer teams
👟 Hire coaches to help train your athletes
📈 Level up your cheerleaders and grow your gym

🎵 **CREATE CUSTOM ROUTINES**
🤸 Build your own routines
💃 Choose moves, stunts, jumps, tumbling, and more
🎶 Create routines that fit your team and make every performance unique

👗 **WARDROBE & CUSTOMIZATION**
🎀 Dress your cheerleaders in different uniforms and outfits
✨ Customize your athletes' looks
👚 Unlock more wardrobe options as you progress

🏆 SO MUCH MORE!
Invite your friends & Enjoy!
